description: This is a Java servlet class named ImageUploadServlet that handles image uploads via HTTP POST requests. It processes multipart form data to retrieve an image file, saves it to a designated folder within the project, and returns the image URL.

classes.name: ImageUploadServlet
classes.description: A servlet class that handles image uploading by processing multipart form data, saving the image to a server directory, and returning the image URL.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to upload an image file, save it to a server directory, and respond with the image URL.
